metrics.label: Certified this quarter
metrics.definition: Products that pass G4 Certify for the first time in the current calendar quarter. A new certification after a G5 does not count.

metrics.label: Median time to production
metrics.definition: Median number of days from G1 Intake to the first G4 Certify. It uses products certified in the last 182 days. A product with a later gate but no G1 is a blocker in the data-quality report.

metrics.label: Median time to first consumer
metrics.definition: Median number of days from G1 Intake to the first consumer. It uses products with a first consumer in the last 182 days. The owners report this date.

metrics.label: Median active users per live product
metrics.definition: Median number of active users in the last 30 days, over live products. The dashboard does not add users across products. A live product without a usage number is not used, and the report shows a warning.

metrics.label: Live products
metrics.definition: Products that are Live (also during a revision).

metrics.label: Products in pipeline
metrics.definition: Products that are In design, In development or In testing.

metrics.label: Certified but unused
metrics.definition: Live products certified 60 or more days ago, with zero active users and no product that uses them. A missing usage number gives a warning, not a flag.

metrics.label: Forecast to go live this quarter
metrics.definition: Products not yet certified, with a planned go-live date from today to the end of the quarter, and a next gate that is not overdue.

metrics.label: Median finish-spec score
metrics.definition: Median finish-spec score from the validation tool, over active products that have a score. The score is the weighted part of the checks that pass. It shows how complete the specification is. It is not a launch approval.

metrics.label: Products failing on the platform
metrics.definition: Active products in NextData that have no running deployment. All their deployments are Failed or Unreachable.

metrics.label: Products never deployed to production
metrics.definition: Active products whose GitHub repository has never deployed to production successfully. Counted over the active products that have a repository.

metrics.label: Median production deployments per shipping product (30 days)
metrics.definition: Median number of successful production deployments in the last 30 days, over active products whose GitHub repository has deployed to production at least once. A product with no production deployment in the period counts as 0.

metrics.label: Deployment failure rate (30 days)
metrics.definition: Share of deployments in the last 30 days, in every environment, that ended in failure or error. Uses the repositories of active products; deployments still running are not counted. The products listed had at least one failure.

flags.label: Behind
flags.definition: The domain is at risk or off track. Certified is less than 90% of the number expected today.

flags.label: Overdue
flags.definition: The next gate is more than 14 days late.

flags.label: Slipping
flags.definition: The planned go-live date moved later two or more times.

flags.label: Unused
flags.definition: Live for 60 or more days, with zero active users and no product that uses it. A missing usage number gives a warning, not a flag.

flags.label: No DPO
flags.definition: The product passed G1 and has no data product owner.

flags.label: Not updated
flags.definition: The owner last reviewed the register row more than 14 days ago. A row that was never reviewed shows "Not yet reported".

flags.label: Pending URN
flags.definition: The product is not in NextData yet. Its URN starts with "pending:".
